title: skills: data-hooks.md teaches the hook/job js-body compile refusal (follow-up of PR #35713)
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUkbQqRUUFSiu2HGob

Filing gate: ③ an owed `Skills-docs:` follow-up, filed by the seat before ACCEPT of PR #35713 (card #34987), per SKILL.md's `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` rule · Source: fleet

## What is owed

PR #35713 (card #34987) makes the save door refuse a hook or job `js` body that does not compile. The new rule ids are `hook-body-does-not-compile` and `job-body-does-not-compile`, sharing `hookBodyFunctionExpression` with the runtime's wrapper. Its PR body reads `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` and `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`.

`skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md`, in its "Sandbox restrictions" section, teaches what a hook body may contain, and it names no compile check. An author who follows the skill today learns of a syntax error only when the hook first runs. After #35713 lands, the save is refused with a coded sentence. The skill should say so, and say it for job bodies too wherever the skill teaches them.

## Done when

- `data-hooks.md` (and the job passage, if a skill teaches job bodies) says that a `js` body that does not compile is refused at save, naming both rule ids. It gives one minimal example of a refused body and its fix.
- The skill's evals exercise the refusal, or the PR states why no eval applies.
- Lands only after PR #35713 has merged, so the skill never teaches a refusal main does not make.

Reader: the `domain:skills` lane. Blocked-by: #34987 (PR #35713).

Grading: area:build · Task · docs follow-up of a narrowing change · evidence: PR #35713 body and `data-hooks.md` on `origin/main`.
Suggested grade: p2 (an owed Skills-docs follow-up of a narrowing change; authors meet the new refusal without the skill naming it).

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue hook-body-does-not-compile` → 0 hits; `data-hooks.md compile` → 0 open hits.
